definitions.explanation: An extremely large size or magnitude. Used as a no-adjective to describe something of the greatest possible size.
In mathematics and science, a point where a function reaches a peak relative to nearby values. Also used for the peak of astronomical events like meteor showers.

examples.japanese: {極大|きょくだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{極大|きょくだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The impact of the typhoon reached its maximum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関数|かんすう}→関数：04796_kansuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極大|きょくだい}{値|ち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: To find the local maximum of a function.

examples.japanese: ペルセウス⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦{流星群|りゅうせいぐん}→流星群：20408_ryuuseigun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧{十二日|じゅうににち}ごろ{極大|きょくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The Perseid meteor shower reaches its peak around August 12th.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{関数|かんすう}→関数：04796_kansuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧x＝3⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{極大|きょくだい}、x＝7⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{極小|きょくしょう}→極小：26067_kyokushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This function has a local maximum at x=3 and a local minimum at x=7.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{十一年|じゅういちねん}⟦{周期|しゅうき}→周期：21707_shuuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{極大|きょくだい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{極小|きょくしょう}→極小：26067_kyokushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: Solar activity repeats a cycle of maximum and minimum roughly every eleven years.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{極|きょく}→極：13150_kyoku⟧ (extreme, pole) and {大|だい} (large). Can function as a no-adjective: {極大|きょくだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (extremely large) is used in general contexts but is fairly formal. Sense 2 (local maximum) is the more common technical usage, appearing in mathematics, physics, and astronomy. In astronomy, {極大|きょくだい} specifically refers to the peak of a periodic phenomenon such as a meteor shower or solar cycle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {極大|きょくだい}{値|ち} — maximum value (math)
- {極大|きょくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ — to reach a peak
- {極大|きょくだい}{期|き} — peak period
- {極大|きょくだい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{極小|きょくしょう}→極小：26067_kyokushou⟧ — maximum and minimum

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧ — greatest, largest; the absolute maximum (vs. {極大|きょくだい} which can be a local maximum)
- ⟦{極小|きょくしょう}→極小：26067_kyokushou⟧ — minimum; extremely small; the antonym
- ⟦{極限|きょくげん}→極限：13231_kyokugen⟧ — limit, extreme; the furthest possible extent
